description: This file defines the StreamingFileSaver class, which provides an API to save files using the File System Access API, allowing users to select a save location and write byte data to disk.

classes.name: StreamingFileSaver
classes.description: A class that facilitates saving files through the File System Access API by allowing users to select a save location and write byte arrays to the file.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of StreamingFileSaver with the specified filename.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the console if logging is enabled.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Checks if the File System Access API's save file picker is available in the current environment.

methods.name: selectFileToSaveTo
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a file location to save to, and initializes the writable stream.

methods.name: pushBytes
methods.description: Writes a chunk of bytes to the currently open writable stream.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Closes the writable stream, finalizing the file save.
